## Behavior

Describe the concrete before/after behavior and affected rooms or integrations.

## Validation

- [ ] YAML and component contract checks pass.
- [ ] Changed IDs have an explicit migration and all consumers are covered.
- [ ] Secrets and runtime storage are excluded.
- [ ] Deployment, required reload/restart and rollback are documented.
- [ ] Installed HA validation and runtime evidence are recorded before calling the release complete.
